dedupe_keys.name: binas online benchmarking tool for water and sanitation services argentina

description: Argentina's Secretariat of Public Works produced BINAS, an online platform for comparative evaluation (benchmarking) of drinking water and sanitation services, with a public data explorer and a login for participating providers. Coverage is Argentina's participating providers, and the platform says it lets an organisation analyse, compare and improve its performance. The public data are free to explore online, and providers register to take part. Caveats: the page shows only the login and explorer entry, so the indicators, years and providers covered could not be listed. Simulation uses: provider performance baselines for water and sanitation service planning. Related records: SUNASS utility benchmarking (data-sunass-peru-utility-benchmarking).
